narrative.details:
Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!

I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.
narrative.objectives: Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in Ruins of Lordaeron for Theodore Griffs in Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText: You killed it??Hmmph. Lucky for you this should be enough ichor to reverse engineer its properties. You do not wish to be an enemy of the Royal Apothecary Society.Get out of my sight!
narrative.requestItemsText: Any fool can tell you the most potent transmission method will always be through the blood.I must see this strain for myself!
